name: glassbridge
description: Desktop-first Android device access and live control framework

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace apps/server && vitest run tests/frontend-backend.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:device: npm run build --workspace apps/server && node --test tests/device-smoke.test.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run desktop:check && npm run desktop:build
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:device && npm run test:rust
scripts.validate:commit: npm run secrets:staged && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.validate:push: npm run secrets:repo && npm run secrets:history && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run rust:fmt:check && npm run rust:check && npm run desktop:check
scripts.validate:full: npm run secrets:repo && npm run secrets:history && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run test:desktop
